_meta.definition: Unifies the tables related to sales transactions, inventory levels, and associated customer and product details, enabling efficient management of sales operations and inventory control.

catalog_sales._description: Tracks detailed sales transactions, including customer and order information, item details, shipping methods, and promotions.

columns.name: cs_sold_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential unique identifiers for sales transaction dates in catalog.

columns.name: cs_sold_time_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential time skips for catalog sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_ship_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integer keys for ship dates in catalog sales data.

columns.name: cs_bill_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique customer IDs for bill sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_bill_cdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for customer demographic groups within catalog sales records.

columns.name: cs_bill_hdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential billing demo key identifiers for catalog sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_bill_addr_sk
columns.description: Unique billing address identifiers across catalog sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_ship_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for the shipping customers involved in catalog sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_ship_cdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique shipping demographic keys for catalog sales records.

columns.name: cs_ship_hdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential home delivery demonstration identifiers for catalog sales.

columns.name: cs_ship_addr_sk
columns.description: Stores unique shipping address identifiers across multiple catalog sales records.

columns.name: cs_call_center_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for call centers associated with catalog sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_catalog_page_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for catalog pages in the sales data.

columns.name: cs_ship_mode_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for various shipping modes used in catalog sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_warehouse_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for warehouses associated with sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_item_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for items in catalog sales data.

columns.name: cs_promo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for promotional sales events in the catalog_sales table.

columns.name: cs_order_number
columns.description: Unique order identifiers across catalog sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_quantity
columns.description: Stores the number of items sold per transaction in the catalog sales database.

columns.name: cs_wholesale_cost
columns.description: Stores wholesale costs for individual items in catalog sales.

columns.name: cs_list_price
columns.description: Stores catalog item list prices in floating point format.

columns.name: cs_sales_price
columns.description: Stores individual sale prices for items in the catalog.

columns.name: cs_ext_discount_amt
columns.description: Stores the external discount amounts for individual sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_ext_sales_price
columns.description: Stores external sales prices in floating point format.

columns.name: cs_ext_wholesale_cost
columns.description: Stores wholesale costs for catalog items in floating point format.

columns.name: cs_ext_list_price
columns.description: Stores external list prices for catalog sales items.

columns.name: cs_ext_tax
columns.description: Stores additional sales tax amounts as floating point figures.

columns.name: cs_coupon_amt
columns.description: Stores the monetary value of coupon discounts applied to sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_ext_ship_cost
columns.description: Stores external shipping costs for catalog sales transactions.

columns.name: cs_net_paid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the cs_net_pa entity

columns.name: cs_net_paid_inc_tax
columns.description: Stores net sales revenue including taxes, in float format.

columns.name: cs_net_paid_inc_ship
columns.description: Stores total net sales revenue including shipping costs in U.S. dollars.

columns.name: cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax
columns.description: Stores net sales including shipping taxes, in floating point format.

columns.name: cs_net_profit
columns.description: Stores net profit (positive for revenue, negative for expenses) in dollars for catalog sales transactions.

inventory._description: Tracks inventory levels for specific items across various warehouses and time periods.

columns.name: inv_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integer keys for inventory date records.

columns.name: inv_item_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for individual items in inventory.

columns.name: inv_warehouse_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for warehouses across inventory records.

columns.name: inv_quantity_on_hand
columns.description: Stores the current count of items available in inventory.

store_sales._description: Records daily sales transactions for items at various stores, including customer details, promotions, and pricing information.

columns.name: ss_sold_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential store sales dates as integers.

columns.name: ss_sold_time_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential sale time segment identifiers (e.g., 65495 represents the same time segment).

columns.name: ss_item_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for items in store sales transactions.

columns.name: ss_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique customer identifiers for each sale record in the store_sales table.

columns.name: ss_cdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores a unique demo customer identifier across store sales facts.

columns.name: ss_hdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores a unique identifier for each historical demo day in store sales data.

columns.name: ss_addr_sk
columns.description: Stores unique store address identifiers across multiple sales records.

columns.name: ss_store_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for sales records.

columns.name: ss_promo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique promotion identifiers for store sales records.

columns.name: ss_ticket_number
columns.description: Stores sequential ticket numbers for each sale transaction.

columns.name: ss_quantity
columns.description: Stores the number of units sold for each store sale transaction.

columns.name: ss_wholesale_cost
columns.description: Stores wholesale costs of individual items in store sales.

columns.name: ss_list_price
columns.description: Stores the individual list prices for items sold in store transactions.

columns.name: ss_sales_price
columns.description: Stores the individual sale prices for items in various transactions.

columns.name: ss_ext_discount_amt
columns.description: Stores the amount of external discounts applied to individual store sales.

columns.name: ss_ext_sales_price
columns.description: Stores external sales prices in float format, ranging from cents to thousands of dollars.

columns.name: ss_ext_wholesale_cost
columns.description: Stores wholesale costs for individual store sales transactions.

columns.name: ss_ext_list_price
columns.description: Stores external list prices for individual items in store sales.

columns.name: ss_ext_tax
columns.description: Stores extended sales tax amounts for individual transactions.

columns.name: ss_coupon_amt
columns.description: Stores the monetary value of coupon discounts applied to individual store sales.

columns.name: ss_net_paid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the ss_net_pa entity

columns.name: ss_net_paid_inc_tax
columns.description: Stores net sales revenue including taxes, in floating point format.

columns.name: ss_net_profit
columns.description: Stores the net profit (positive for revenue, negative for expenses) in floating point format.

web_sales._description: Tracks online sales data, including customer details, item information, shipping details, and associated promotions.

columns.name: ws_sold_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential sale dates as integer surrogate keys.

columns.name: ws_sold_time_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential sale time identifiers for a single day (73313).

columns.name: ws_ship_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential identifiers for ship dates in web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_item_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for items involved in web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_bill_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique customer IDs for web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_bill_cdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores a unique identifier for customer demographic groups within web sales.

columns.name: ws_bill_hdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential demo bill identifiers for web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_bill_addr_sk
columns.description: Stores unique billing address identifiers for web sales, repeated for multiple transactions with the same billing address.

columns.name: ws_ship_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for the customers to whom web sales are shipped.

columns.name: ws_ship_cdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores the shipping demo sequence number for each web sales record (41329 repeated).

columns.name: ws_ship_hdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores the home demonstration shipment ID for each web sales record, consistently set to 1140 in these samples.

columns.name: ws_ship_addr_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for shipping addresses associated with web sales.

columns.name: ws_web_page_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for web pages associated with sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_web_site_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for the websites associated with web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_ship_mode_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for various shipping modes used in web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_warehouse_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for warehouses associated with web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_promo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for promotional events associated with web sales.

columns.name: ws_order_number
columns.description: Unique order identifiers for web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_quantity
columns.description: Stores the number of units sold per web sales transaction.

columns.name: ws_wholesale_cost
columns.description: Stores wholesale costs for individual items in web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_list_price
columns.description: Stores web sales list prices, represented as floating point numbers.

columns.name: ws_sales_price
columns.description: Stores individual sale prices for web transactions (e.g., 38.04, 26.41, etc.).

columns.name: ws_ext_discount_amt
columns.description: Stores external discount amounts for individual web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_ext_sales_price
columns.description: Stores external sales prices in floating point format.

columns.name: ws_ext_wholesale_cost
columns.description: Stores wholesale costs (in dollars) for individual web sales.

columns.name: ws_ext_list_price
columns.description: Stores external list prices for individual web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_ext_tax
columns.description: Stores external taxes applied to individual web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_coupon_amt
columns.description: Stores the monetary value of coupon discounts applied to web sales.

columns.name: ws_ext_ship_cost
columns.description: Stores external shipping costs for web sales transactions.

columns.name: ws_net_paid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the ws_net_pa entity

columns.name: ws_net_paid_inc_tax
columns.description: Stores web sales amounts including taxes, in floating point format.

columns.name: ws_net_paid_inc_ship
columns.description: Stores total net sales revenue including shipping costs.

columns.name: ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax
columns.description: Stores net sales including shipping taxes, in floating point format.

columns.name: ws_net_profit
columns.description: Stores web sales transaction net profits as floating point numbers.
